decision: Standardize on Postgres as the primary database for all new services.
rationale: Team already knows it; strong JSON support; one fewer system to operate.

decision: All public APIs use REST with OpenAPI specs; no GraphQL this quarter.
rationale: Keep client integration simple while the team is small.

decision: Code freeze every Thursday 5pm; releases ship on Friday mornings only.
rationale: Avoid weekend incidents from late-Friday deploys.

decision: Use GitHub Actions for CI; do not introduce Jenkins or CircleCI.
rationale: Already included in our plan; no extra vendor.

decision: Authentication uses short-lived JWTs (15 min) with refresh tokens; no server-side sessions.
rationale: Stateless services scale horizontally without sticky sessions.

decision: Frontend stays on React with TypeScript; no new framework migrations before the Q1 release.
rationale: Avoid churn ahead of the release.
